description: This file contains functions related to user management for the TestLink project, including session handling, user retrieval, password reset, and authorization checks.

methods.name: setUserSession
methods.description: Sets session data after user modification or authorization, including handling cookies and current project context.

methods.name: getUsersForHtmlOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a map of users suitable for populating HTML <select> options, possibly filtered by activity status.

methods.name: buildUserMap
methods.description: Builds a map of user display names keyed by user ID for HTML form options, optionally including inactive users.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets a user's password in the database, optionally emailing or displaying it.

methods.name: getUserErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable message corresponding to a user operation status code.

methods.name: getAllUsersRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all users with their roles, with optional ordering.

methods.name: getTestersForHtmlOptions
methods.description: Returns users with rights on a specific test plan and project suitable for assigning as testers.

methods.name: initialize_tabsmenu
methods.description: Initializes a structure representing user permissions for UI tabs.

methods.name: getGrantsForUserMgmt
methods.description: Determines user/mgmt rights and permissions for user and role management pages.

methods.name: setUserSessionFromObj
methods.description: Sets user session data from a user object.
